scenarios.name: Derelict with a nest
scenarios.description: A drifting wreck, power out, something breeding in the dark.
hooks: Resin-coated bulkheads lead toward a warm, humid hold. Whatever grew here is still growing.
The flight recorder shows the last crew sealing themselves in the cargo bay from the outside.

scenarios.name: Colony under siege
scenarios.description: A frontier colony that stopped answering the relay.
hooks: The perimeter lights are on but nobody is at the gate. Barricades face inward.
A child's voice repeats a single call-sign on the colony band.

scenarios.name: Prison riot
scenarios.description: Cell blocks in lockdown, the guards gone quiet.
hooks: Half the cell doors are open from the inside.
The warden's office is locked, and someone is still using the intercom.

scenarios.name: Corporate black site
scenarios.description: A secret lab that was never on any registry.
hooks: Every specimen tank is empty. The cleaning logs say otherwise.
A sealed vault holds the only copy of the project file, and a long list of names.

scenarios.name: Quarantine station
scenarios.description: Sealed wards and a hypersleep vault. Nobody was supposed to wake.
hooks: One sleeper pod is open and still warm.
The quarantine order was signed by someone who left the company years ago.

scenarios.name: Abandoned mining colony
scenarios.description: Deep shafts, stripped stores, and a headframe that still hums.
hooks: The lift works. Nobody can say who is sending it down.
The deepest level is not on the survey.

scenarios.name: Orbital station adrift
scenarios.description: A ghost station with its lights on and its crew accounted for. Mostly.
hooks: Docking rings 2 and 3 are missing from the structure but present on the manifest.

scenarios.name: Military outpost, cut off
scenarios.description: A garrison that fought something it could not stop.
hooks: The armoury is empty and the sentry guns are pointing at the barracks.

scenarios.name: Tidy corporate ship
scenarios.description: A well-kept merchant, no trouble at all. Suspiciously clean.
hooks: The cargo manifest does not match the cargo.
